title: Musical Shaker Instrument Recalled by Woodstock Percussion Due to Laceration and Choking Hazard
summary: The handle can detach from the shaker, exposing a rough edge and posing a laceration hazard. The detached handle also exposes small steel pellets and a plastic plug which pose choking hazards. Units: About 9,400 in the U.S. and 700 in Canada.

title: Janome America Inc. Recalls Elna Sewing Machines Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The wires inside the sewing machine can short circuit, posing a risk of fire. Units: About 600.

title: Kahn Enterprises Recalls Beeni Baby Hats Due to Asphyxiation Hazard
summary: A baby can spit up during use, posing an asphyxiation hazard. Units: About 35.

title: Child's Entrapment Death Prompts Big Lots Recall of Metal Futon Bunk Beds
summary: Children behind the futon or in the ladder area of the bunk bed can get entrapped when the futon and its metal frame are lowered from the seated to the flat position. Also, the space between the last rung on the bunk bed's ladder and the futon mattress is too small, which can allow a child's body to

title: aDOORable Swing Bar Recalled by Sportime Due to Fall Hazard
summary: A welded eye hook on the swing bar can break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 600 (U.S.).

title: Emma's Garden Polka-Dot Girls' Dresses Recalled by TJX Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The decorative buttons on the front of the dress can detach, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 21,000 in the U.S.; 2,600 in Canada.

title: Target Expands Recall of Child Booster Seats Following Additional Reports of Falls
summary: The booster seat's restraint buckle can open unexpectedly, allowing a child to fall from the chair and be injured. Units: About 375,000 (This recall was first announced in Aug. 2009).

title: Calphalon Recalls to Repair Contemporary Cutlery Knife Block Sets Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The tips of the 8- inch slicing knife and/or the 8-inch bread knife can protrude through the bottom slot row on the wooden block holder, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 217,000 in the United States; 300 in Canada.

title: General Electric, Sharp Recalls GE Air Conditioning and Heating Units Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An electrical component in the heating system can fail, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 90,600.

title: Harbinger Fitness Recalls Ab Straps Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The plastic buckle on the ab straps can break, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 4,169.

title: Excite USA Recalls Toy Helicopters Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Rite Aid Stores
summary: The plastic blades of the helicopter can detach during operation, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 24,000.

title: Husqvarna Recalls TuffTorq Yard Tractors Due to Loss of Braking Ability
summary: The yard tractor's transaxle can experience intermittent drive failure, posing a risk of reduced or lost braking ability. Units: About 1,600.

title: Quality Bicycle Products Recalls Civia Bicycle Racks Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bicycle rack's mounting bracket can crack or break. When this happens, the rack can fall onto the bicycle's front wheel, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 100.

title: EKSuccess Brands Recalls American Girl Crafts Jewelry Kit Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The surface coating on some of the beads contains excessive levels of lead, which is prohibited under federal law. Units: About 75,000.

title: Venmar Ventilation Recalls Air Exchangers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The motor in the air exchangers can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,400 in the United States.

title: Children's Sleepwear Recalled by Sage Creek Organics Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The garments fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear posing a risk of burn injury to children. The garments are being recalled because they do not meet the tight-fitting sizing requirements. Units: About 600.

title: Cost Plus Inc. Recalls Wooden Animal Drum Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The paint used on the drum is in excess of the maximum allowable level of 90 ppm, a violation of the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 1,000.

title: Hamilton Beach Recalls Toasters Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The heating element in these toasters can remain energized indefinitely when an item is placed in the toaster which may ignite the contents, posing a fire hazard if the toaster is near flammable items. Units: About 300,000.

title: International Vitamin Corporation Recalls Live Better Vitamins Due to Failure to Meet Child-Resistant Closure Requirement
summary: The iron supplements are not in child-resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. Ingesting multiple iron supplement tablets at once can cause serious injury or death to young children. Units: About 12,000 units.

title: Risk of Strangulation Prompts Recall to Repair Roman Shades by The Shade Store
summary: Strangulations can occur when a child places his/her neck between the exposed inner cord and the fabric on the backside of the blind or when a child pulls the cord out and wraps it around his/her neck. Units: About 45,000 Roman shades.

title: Wm. Wright Co. Recalls Roman Shade Kits due to Risk of Strangulation
summary: Strangulations can occur when a child places his/her neck between the exposed inner cord and the fabric on the backside of the shade, or when a child pulls the cord out and wraps it around his/her neck. Units: About 48,000.

title: Women's Multivitamins Recalled by GNC Due to Failure to Meet Child-Resistant Closure Requirements (Recall Alert)
summary: The product contains iron, but does not have child-resistant packaging as required by federal law. If ingested by a child, these vitamins could cause serious injury or death. Units: About 2,500.

title: Club Car Recalls Golf Cars and Hospitality, Utility and Transport Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The brake pedal mounting blocks can crack and separate, resulting in a loss of braking ability. This can result in a crash. Units: About 800 (This recall was first announced in November 2010).

title: Swing Sets Recalled by Adventure Playsets due to Fall Hazard
summary: The wood in the posts of the fort sections on the swing sets can weaken due to rotting, posing a fall hazard. Units: Approximately 240,000; a number of these products were recalled in November 2009 for a similar hazard, which listed 275,000 playsets in the U.S. and 6,800 in Canada..

title: Topson Downs of California Recalls Women's Dresses Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The dresses fail to meet the federal flammability standard for wearing apparel, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,100.

title: American Honda Recalls Portable Generators
summary: The hazard labels attached to the batteries used on the generators are printed in Japanese instead of English. As a result, consumers handling the battery may not be able to adequately avoid risks associated with the batteries. Units: About 2,500.

title: Britax Recalls B-Nimble Strollers Due to Risk of Brake Failure
summary: An audible click heard when the brake pedal is pressed can give a false impression that the brake is fully engaged when it is not. When the brake is not engaged, the stroller can move unexpectedly posing a risk of injury to the child occupant. Units: About 20,000 in the United States and 800 in Cana

title: GAMMA Sports Recalls Children's Tennis Racquets Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The orange grip tape on the tennis racket's handle contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 2,000.

title: Rugby Children's Pain & Fever Concentrated Drops Recalled Due To Failure to Meet Child-Resistant Closure Requirement
summary: This over the counter medicine contains acetaminophen which calls for child-resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. Although the original bottle has child-resistant packaging, a separate dropper unit provided for dispensing the drug to children does not. When in use,

title: Target Recalls Infant Girls Sandals Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The decorative plastic flowers can detach, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 51,700.

title: Napa Home & Garden Recalls NAPAfire and FIREGEL Pourable Gel Fuel Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The pourable gel fuel can ignite unexpectedly and splatter onto people and objects nearby when it is poured into a firepot that is still burning. title: Christmas Tree Shops Recall Animated Safari and Aquarium Lamps Due to Fire and Shock Hazards
summary: Defective wiring in the lamps can cause an electrical short, posing fire and shock hazards to consumers. Units: About 35,000.

title: MTD Recalls TrimmerPlus Edger Attachments Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The steel shaft that drives the edger blade can break during use causing the edger blade to detach. If the blade detaches, it can hit the user or bystanders, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 14,500.
